policies.description: Telnet must be disabled on all VTY lines
policies.remediation:
line vty 0 4
 transport input ssh
line vty 5 15
 transport input ssh

policies.description: SSH must be version 2 only (version 1 is insecure)
policies.remediation: ip ssh version 2

policies.description: VTY exec-timeout must be 10 minutes or less (prevent abandoned sessions)
policies.remediation:
line vty 0 4
 exec-timeout 10 0
line vty 5 15
 exec-timeout 10 0

policies.description: Console exec-timeout must be configured (prevent unattended console access)
policies.remediation:
line con 0
 exec-timeout 15 0

policies.description: Enable secret must be configured (not enable password)
policies.remediation:
enable secret {ENABLE_SECRET}
! Replace {ENABLE_SECRET} with your organization's enable password

policies.description: Service password-encryption must be enabled
policies.remediation: service password-encryption

policies.description: HTTP server must be disabled (use HTTPS only)
policies.check_command: show running-config | include ip http server
policies.remediation: no ip http server

policies.description: NTP must be synchronized to a reliable time source
At least one NTP server must be configured
policies.remediation:
ntp server {NTP_SERVER_1} prefer
ntp server {NTP_SERVER_2}

policies.description: SNMPv3 must be configured (SNMPv1/v2c are insecure)
Default SNMP community strings (public/private) must be removed
policies.remediation:
no snmp-server community public
no snmp-server community private

policies.description: SNMP location must be configured (format: SITE/FLOOR/RACK)
policies.remediation:
snmp-server location {SITE}/{FLOOR}/{RACK}
! Example: snmp-server location NYC/2/A03

policies.description: SNMP contact must be configured
policies.remediation:
snmp-server contact {NOC_EMAIL}
! Example: snmp-server contact noc@company.com

policies.description: Syslog server must be configured
Local logging buffer must be configured
policies.remediation: logging buffered 16384 informational

policies.description: Log timestamps must be enabled for accurate event correlation
policies.remediation: service timestamps log datetime msec localtime show-timezone

policies.description: Login banner must be configured (legal requirement)
policies.remediation:
banner login ^
*** AUTHORIZED ACCESS ONLY ***
This system is the property of {ORG_NAME}.
Unauthorized access is prohibited and will be prosecuted.
All activity is monitored and logged.
^
! Replace {ORG_NAME} with your organization name

policies.description: MOTD banner must be configured
policies.remediation:
banner motd ^
{ORG_NAME} Network Infrastructure
Authorized personnel only.
^

policies.description: Hostname must not be the factory default (Router/Switch)
IP domain name must be configured (required for SSH key generation)
policies.remediation:
ip domain-name {DOMAIN_NAME}
! Example: ip domain-name corp.company.com

policies.description: CDP must be disabled on edge/uplink interfaces facing untrusted networks
Access ports must have PortFast and BPDU Guard enabled
policies.remediation:
spanning-tree portfast default
spanning-tree portfast bpduguard default

policies.description: AAA new-model must be enabled
policies.remediation: aaa new-model

policies.description: At least one local user account must be configured as fallback
policies.remediation:
username {ADMIN_USER} privilege 15 secret {ADMIN_PASS}
! Replace {ADMIN_USER} and {ADMIN_PASS} with your values

policies.description: IP routing must be enabled on Layer 3 switches
policies.remediation: ip routing

policies.description: A default route or default-information originate must be configured
policies.remediation:
ip route 0.0.0.0 0.0.0.0 {GATEWAY_IP}
! Replace {GATEWAY_IP} with your default gateway

policies.description: IP source routing must be disabled (security hardening)
policies.remediation: no ip source-route

policies.description: IP proxy ARP should be disabled on routed interfaces
QoS service policy must be applied on uplink interfaces
HSRP or VRRP must be configured on gateway interfaces
Spanning Tree must use Rapid-PVST or MST (not legacy STP)
policies.remediation: spanning-tree mode rapid-pvst

policies.description: Root Guard must be configured on access/edge ports
Unused interfaces must be administratively shut down
policies.remediation:
! Shut down all unused interfaces:
interface range {UNUSED_RANGE}
 shutdown
 description UNUSED-DISABLED

policies.description: CDP must be disabled on edge/access ports facing end users
Storm control must be configured on access ports
policies.remediation:
! Apply on access interfaces:
interface {ACCESS_INTERFACE}
 storm-control broadcast level 20
 storm-control multicast level 20
 storm-control action shutdown

policies.description: A dedicated management VLAN must be configured
ACL must restrict VTY access to management hosts only
policies.remediation:
ip access-list standard MGMT-ACCESS
 permit {MGMT_SUBNET} {MGMT_WILDCARD}
 deny any log
line vty 0 4
 access-class MGMT-ACCESS in
! Replace {MGMT_SUBNET} and {MGMT_WILDCARD} with your management subnet

policies.description: SNMP access must be restricted via ACL
policies.remediation:
ip access-list standard SNMP-ACCESS
 permit {NMS_HOST}
 deny any log
snmp-server community {COMMUNITY} RO SNMP-ACCESS

policies.description: Finger service must be disabled
policies.remediation: no service finger

policies.description: TCP small servers must be disabled
policies.remediation: no service tcp-small-servers

policies.description: UDP small servers must be disabled
policies.remediation: no service udp-small-servers

policies.description: CPU utilization must be below 80% (5-minute average)
policies.check_command: show processes cpu | include CPU utilization
policies.remediation:
! High CPU — investigate with:
show processes cpu sorted
show processes cpu history
! Common causes: routing protocol flap, spanning-tree TCN, high traffic

policies.description: Memory utilization must be below 85%
policies.remediation:
! Check memory with:
show processes memory sorted
! If consistently high, consider platform upgrade

policies.description: No interfaces should have excessive input/output errors
RSA crypto key must be generated (required for SSH)
policies.remediation:
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048
! Minimum 2048-bit key for modern SSH compliance

policies.description: SSH RSA key must be at least 2048 bits
policies.remediation:
crypto key zeroize rsa
crypto key generate rsa modulus 2048

policies.description: Configuration change archive/logging must be enabled
policies.remediation:
archive
 log config
  logging enable
  logging size 200
  notify syslog contenttype plaintext
  hidekeys

policies.description: AAA accounting must be configured for audit trail
TACACS+ or RADIUS must be configured for centralized auth
Juniper root authentication must be configured
policies.remediation:
set system root-authentication encrypted-password "{ENCRYPTED_PASS}"
! Generate with: openssl passwd -6 yourpassword

policies.description: Juniper commit confirmed should be used for risky changes
policies.remediation:
! Best practice: always use commit confirmed 5 for risky changes
! This gives a 5-minute rollback window if connectivity is lost

policies.description: Juniper NTP server must be configured
policies.remediation:
set system ntp server {NTP_SERVER_1} prefer
set system ntp server {NTP_SERVER_2}

policies.description: Juniper syslog must be configured to send to external server
policies.remediation:
set system syslog host {SYSLOG_SERVER} any info
set system syslog host {SYSLOG_SERVER} authorization info
